newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Weak mark pressures Bulgaria lev vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Weak mark pressures Bulgaria lev vs dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev eased to 1,829-1,834 per dollar at the opening from Thursday's close of 1,828-1,831, tracking the weakening mark/dollar on global markets, dealers said.
* The lev was unchanged against the mark at 995-996, close to the Bulgarian National Bank currency board fixed mark bid of 995.
* The lev was pegged at 1,000 per mark as anchor currency in an IMF-prescribed fixed exchange rate mechanism known as a currency board, introduced on July 1 to restore confidence in the lev.

* Mark/dollar fell below 1.8400 in late Tokyo on Friday, its lowest level since July 1991. Mark/dollar stood at 1.8375/85 in Europe around 1300 GMT on Thursday, when Bulgaria's market closed. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 91188
